Woman Jumps Into Pond With Deity Idol After Entering Temple Naked

A woman engineer entered a temple in Hyderabad in a nude state and subsequently jumped into a pond with a deity idol. Her body was later recovered from the pond. The idol, however, remains missing. The incident caused a stir and has been reported by multiple Hindi news outlets.
